name: OpenThesaurus
label: OpenThesaurus German Thesaurus
description: Official OpenThesaurus JSON API (German). synonyms only. No key. Required User-Agent with contact. Link to openthesaurus.de. Max 60 req/min/IP.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for OpenThesaurus. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"synonyms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: synonyms. Example: 'synonyms'.

schema.label: q
schema.description: German search word. URL-encode umlauts. Example: Test.

schema.label: similar
schema.description: true to include similar spellings. Example: true.

schema.label: substring
schema.description: true for substring matches. Example: true.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: synonyms. Example: 'synonyms'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
